All-to-all attention is made of weighted sums, so permuting the inputs permutes the outputs, and their mean doesn't change. Without position vectors, an image is a bag of patches to a transformer; in the ViT paper this variant gives 0.614 versus 0.642 with positions, on ImageNet with five examples per class. Which way you encode position, one-dimensional or two-dimensional, hardly matters.

Meanwhile, the encoder knows what it sees: its nearest caption in the contrastive space is “purple cube” for ${r.encHeld * 8} of 8 images.
Знание энкодера дошло до слов: цвет и ф: The encoder's knowledge made it into the words: color and shape are encoded separately, and the language model read both. That's how CLIPort in lesson 2.1 took colors that weren't in the demonstrations from CLIP.
Цвет языковая модель прочитала из карти: The language model read the color from the image, but finished the shape after the word “purple” from the captions: among the 200 captions, “purple” was followed by ball, bowl and can, but never by cube, and this text experience outweighed the image tokens. The LLaVA authors describe the same failure: asked about strawberry-flavored yogurt, the model answered “yes”, although the fridge held only yogurt and strawberries. The cure is caption diversity, and that's why PaliGemma trains on a billion examples.

Предобученный энкодер: ${pc(r.accA)} на: Pretrained encoder: ${pc(r.accA)} on new images; encoder from scratch: ${pc(r.accB)}. Exactly how many points apart they are is a matter of chance: the from-scratch model learns unstably, and over ten different random seeds the gap ranges from 5 to 32 points, but the pretrained encoder is ahead on every one. During contrastive pre-training the encoder saw 600 × 16 = 9,600 images of all combinations, while the encoder from scratch got 200, and some of its mistakes are on combinations it saw only 8–9 times each. This is LLaVA's argument: the CLIP encoder, trained on 400 million pairs, is taken ready-made and left untouched, and only the bridge to the language model is trained. PaliGemma does fine-tune its encoder, but on a billion examples and with a slow warm-up of its learning rate; we don't have that kind of data.

Nobody compares them with words directly: they enter attention as keys and values, and only the readout is drawn toward the words. Alignment means that the frozen model has learned to extract what it needs from these tokens, not that an image token has become similar to a word.

ViT читает картинку по пикселям, как тек: Does ViT read an image pixel by pixel, the way text is read letter by letter?
Да, каждый пиксель — токен: Yes, every pixel is a token
Нет: картинку режут на патчи 16 × 16, и: No: the image is cut into 16 × 16 patches, and the linear projection of a patch becomes a token
Нет: токены даёт свёрточная сеть: No: the tokens come from a convolutional network
Патч 16 × 16 × 3 разворачивают в 768 чис: A 16 × 16 × 3 patch is flattened into 768 numbers and multiplied by a single trainable matrix; 224 × 224 gives 196 tokens. Pixels as tokens would mean 50,000 tokens and attention 65,000 times more expensive.
Без позиционных векторов ViT перестаёт р: Does ViT stop working without positional vectors?
Да, не обучается вовсе: Yes, it doesn't train at all
Нет: работает заметно хуже, 0,614 против: No: it works noticeably worse, 0.614 versus 0.642 in the ablation, because it sees a bag of patches
Нет, разницы нет: патчи и так в порядке: No, there's no difference: the patches are in order anyway
Внимание не знает порядка входов: в инте: Attention doesn't know the order of its inputs: in the interactive, the shuffled image without positions gave the same output. Positions bring the order back; which way you encode them, one-dimensional, two-dimensional or relative, hardly matters.
Проектор в LLaVA — большая отдельная сет: Is the projector in LLaVA a large separate network?
Да, трансформер на сотни миллионов парам: Yes, a transformer with hundreds of millions of parameters
Нет: одна обучаемая матрица, переводящая: No: a single trainable matrix that maps the encoder tokens to the width of the language model's embeddings; in LLaVA-1.5, a two-layer MLP
Это кросс-внимание внутри языковой модел: It's cross-attention inside the language model
В статье H_v = W · Z_v. Авторы PaliGemma: In the paper, H_v = W · Z_v. The PaliGemma authors compared a linear projector and an MLP: 77.2 versus 77.1 points. The bridge between the parts is cheap; what's expensive is the parts themselves and the data.
Энкодер картинок в LLaVA дообучают на ин: Is the image encoder in LLaVA fine-tuned on the instructions?
Нет: энкодер CLIP заморожен всегда; на п: No: the CLIP encoder is always frozen; in the first stage only the projector learns, in the second the projector and the language model
В LLaVA заморожено то, что уже обучено н: In LLaVA, what's frozen is what was already trained on a large corpus. PaliGemma does it differently and freezes nothing, but it trains on a billion examples and with a slow warm-up of the encoder's learning rate.
Токены картинки в PaliGemma видят только: Do the image tokens in PaliGemma see only the previous tokens, like words in GPT?
Да, маска каузальная для всей последоват: Yes, the mask is causal for the whole sequence
Нет: внимание префиксное — картинка и за: No: the attention is prefix attention — the image and the prompt see each other in full, and only the answer has a causal mask
Нет: картинка не участвует во внимании: No: the image doesn't take part in attention
Так токены картинки могут «подсмотреть»: This way the image tokens can “peek” at the question and adjust to it. The authors tried a causal mask on the prompt and on the image: both work worse.
Сколько токенов даёт одна картинка в Pal: How many tokens does one image give in PaliGemma at 224 px?
Картинку приводят к квадрату 224, 448 ил: The image is resized to a square of 224, 448 or 896 pixels, which gives 256, 1024 or 4096 tokens. For a robot, this is the price of every control step: GR00T N1 keeps 64 tokens per frame.
Инструкции для обучения LLaVA размечали: Were the instructions for training LLaVA written by human annotators?
Нет: текстовая GPT-4 написала их по подп: No: a text-only GPT-4 wrote them from the captions and bounding boxes of COCO images, without seeing the images
158 тысяч примеров: 58 тысяч диалогов, 2: 158,000 examples: 58,000 conversations, 23,000 descriptions, 77,000 reasoning answers. GPT-4 never saw the images, only the text captions and box coordinates.
